parsed_content.name: Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card

fee_schedule.forex_markup_note: 1.99% forex markup is charged on transactions made in currencies other than INR. Applies to international POS payments and online purchases charged in foreign currency.Examples (1.99%):₹100 → ₹1.99₹1,000 → ₹19.9₹10,000 → ₹199₹1,00,000 → ₹1990
fee_schedule.atm_withdrawal_note: 2.5% of the withdrawn amount is charged on cash advances using the credit card (minimum ₹500, if applicable).
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge: As prescribed by IRCTC / Indian Railways
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge_note: Surcharge on booking or cancelling railway tickets will be levied as prescribed by IRCTC or Indian Railways and may vary based on their applicable charges.
fee_schedule.late_payment_note: Additional ₹100 is charged if Minimum Amount Due remains unpaid for two consecutive cycles, continuing until cleared

rewards.redemption_options: This is a cashback card, and the earned cashback is adjusted directly in your monthly statement.
rewards.exclusions: Physical and Digital Gold, EMI Transactions, EMI , Rent Payments, Tax Payments, Amazon.com, Fuel Spends, International Spends, International Transactions
rewards.exclusion_spends: Physical and Digital Gold, EMI Transactions, EMI , Rent Payments, Tax Payments, Amazon.com, Fuel Spends, International Spends, International Transactions

detailed_benefits.details:
• 5% unlimited cashback on Amazon purchases for Prime members with no capping
• 3% unlimited cashback on Amazon purchases for non-Prime members with no capping
• 2% cashback on spends at 100+ partner merchants with no capping
• 1% unlimited cashback on all other spends with no capping
• Reward points earned on every ₹100 spent and credited as Amazon Pay balance for easy redemption
